edits.old: - No personal data in logs, tests or prompts: the read returns business keys, flags and amounts only — no name, address, identity number or contact value — and the run log carries counts and key types, never a key with a personal field beside it; test data is synthetic and the keys are ACE business keys.
edits.new: - Personal data is carried and is kept out of logs, tests and prompts (Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5): `person_key`, `account_key` and `contract_no` are indirect identifiers (Confidential); `deceased_flag`, `vulnerable`, `deceased_override` and `bankruptcy` are Sensitive (Restricted), masked unless the role handles the deviation, never logged, and their read is audited through the ACE Common PII path; `fraud_flag`, `dispute_open`, `days_past_due` and `total_balance` are customer data (Confidential). The read returns no name, address, identity number or contact value, the run log carries counts and key types and never a clear key or a flag value, and test data is synthetic.
